scope: every news / information source GIR reads on 21 Nov 2026 (v2 + old system still running) and every host in design_v3 WEB_SOURCES.md + COLLECTION_PLAN.md

status_rules.LIVE: polls succeed and items flowed on the last weekday with median lag <= 10 min (or a dated daily file arrived on time)
status_rules.SLOW: works, but median lag > 10 min, partial coverage, or only through Google News
status_rules.SILENT: polled but nothing arrives when the last weekday says it should (blocked, dead feed, or broken parse)
status_rules.NOT BUILT: planned in the design docs, nobody reads it

weekend_note: Audit run Saturday 21 Nov ~13:50 IST. Indian sources are quiet on Saturdays, so 'last item' and 'silent' were judged against Friday 20 Nov (items_fri_20nov).
